package rulefixtures

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
)

// scenario for error_string_comparison: `if err.Error() == "some error"` string comparison for error checking
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: warning.

var ErrNotFound = errors.New("not found")

func lookupUser(id int) (string, error) {
	if id <= 0 {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid id: %w", ErrNotFound)
	}
	return "user_" + fmt.Sprint(id), nil
}

func handleRequest(id int) error {
	name, err := lookupUser(id)
	if err != nil && err.Error() == "not found" {
		return fmt.Errorf("skipping: %w", err)
	}
	fmt.Println(name)
	return err
}
